editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: FP Markets is a legitimate ASIC/CySEC-regulated broker scoring 7.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. Raw account at 0.0 pips + $6 RT is among the cheapest. Five platform options (MT4, MT5, cTrader, TradingView, IRESS) give the widest choice available. 10,000+ instruments including DMA stocks via IRESS. 19 years of operation without major enforcement action. Best for multi-platform traders wanting ECN pricing with DMA stock access.
